#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <set>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int n1 = n / 2;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a1, a2;

    // Generate all possible sums for the first half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_sums1 = [&](int i, unsigned long total) {
        if (i == n1) {
            a1.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_sums1(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_sums1(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    // Generate all possible sums for the second half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_sums2 = [&](int i, unsigned long total) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_sums2(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_sums2(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    generate_sums1(0, 0);
    generate_sums2(n1, 0);

    // Remove duplicates and sort
    std::set<unsigned long> a1_set(a1.begin(), a1.end());
    std::vector<unsigned long> a1_sorted(a1_set.begin(), a1_set.end());

    unsigned long max_sum = 0;
    for (auto val : a2) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(a1_sorted.begin(), a1_sorted.end(), m - val);
        if (it != a1_sorted.begin()) {
            auto idx = it - a1_sorted.begin();
            if (idx > 0) {
                unsigned long candidate = a1_sorted[idx - 1] + val;
                if (candidate > max_sum) {
                    max_sum = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_sum << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
